name: WLOKU
author: 12Boti
description: A two-player game on a cave-like map, with P1 and P2 starting on opposite sides. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

descriptions.en: A two-player game on a cave-like map, with P1 and P2 starting on opposite sides. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.
descriptions.it: Un gioco per due giocatori su una mappa simile a una caverna, con P1 e P2 ai lati opposti. Creato per la prima game jam di WASM-4.
